note: Corps of Engineers campground on the west shore of Hensley Lake (Fresno River) just north of Hidden Dam, about 15 mi NE of Madera. The reservoir runs highest in spring and is often low by mid-summer. The entrance gate is closed 10 PM to 6 AM. --Claude
summary: rec.gov facility, rates, catalog and calendar + imagery read. 53 sites (2 group, 13 tent-only), max 90 ft per catalog; 50 A electric and water at 15-17 sites; flush/showers/dump/water; year-round; max stay 14; 2027 $20 non-electric / $30 electric. Lakeview holds. Pin ~1.7 km off (at the dam's south end) -> 37.1225,-119.8926. Phone '' -> 559-831-7040.
